text: Hi, I'm an AI presenter. Accnomos was built by a UK business owner who gets paid, and pays suppliers, through PayPal. Here's how it keeps the books.
Small businesses paid through PayPal still match the fees and the VAT by hand.
PayPal's data comes in, the AI proposes, code calculates to the penny, and the owner approves.

Press Sync PayPal, and Accnomos fetches every payment from PayPal itself: the gross, PayPal's fee and the net, matched to the invoice it pays. A sale with no invoice waits for you to choose its VAT. Nothing posts until you approve.
Turn on the Power grid, and you can tick several PayPal rows and approve them together, with totals. Or just type: PayPal fees over five pounds.
Or just ask, in your own words. Did that client pay the arrears? Accnomos checks your books and PayPal itself. A stationery order last month, around £100? Exactly £97.79.
say: Or just ask, in your own words. Did that client pay the arrears? Accnomos checks your books and PayPal itself. A stationery order last month, around a hundred pounds? Exactly ninety-seven pounds seventy-nine.

text: The tie-out checks the books against PayPal's own balance, shows when PayPal last refreshed it, and explains any difference.

Paying a supplier works the other way. When a bill falls due, Accnomos offers a PayPal payout. You approve, PayPal confirms in about half a minute, and only then does it post. A retry never pays twice. PayPal can't date a payout ahead, so it goes on the due date, when the app is open.
If a customer opens a dispute, Accnomos builds the evidence pack from the books, checks every figure by code, and waits for you to read it before anything goes to PayPal.
Everywhere in Accnomos, the AI proposes, code checks the figures, and you approve.

And PayPal sits inside a full set of books, kept in your own OneDrive or Google Drive. Scan receipts, match the bank, and file VAT to HMRC's sandbox. Reports, voice, jobs and payroll, on the web and Android, with upcoming PayPal payments in your calendar and help when you need it.

text: And that's everything Accnomos does today, in one app.
Everything you saw runs on PayPal's sandbox. Try it yourself at accnomos.com, no sign-in needed.
